Excursion booking terms

Book separately from the cruise, with reservation and full payment at least 45 days before departure. Includes an English-speaking guide, round-trip coach transfers and admission to specified attractions. Minimum group: 40 passengers; you will be notified in advance if the minimum is not met. Limited seats, first come, first served.

Tours are optional and are not included in the booking total.

How to connect onboard
  1. Turn off mobile data and connect to Mediterranea Wi-Fi.
  2. Open the ship’s internet portal in your browser, or use Alipay to scan the QR code in the supplied guide.
  3. Select 中文 (Chinese) at the top right, then “Access the Internet” or the equivalent. Enter your personal information and log in.
  4. Choose and purchase a package. Use the portal to log out when finished.

The guide does not provide the portal URL. Ask the onboard team for help accessing it.

Before you sail Guests, luggage & fees

Travelling with children

Infants must be at least 6 months old on the sailing date. Infants aged 6 months–2 years pay the adult cruise fare, with the USD 150 port charge waived. Children pay the adult fare, with or without a bed. Guests under 4 years are exempt from cruise gratuities.

Bringing your own pram or cot? Notify Customer Care at least 45 days before sailing for the required paperwork. Failure to notify may result in denied boarding.

Age exemptions need a separate quote

The calculator currently applies standard port charges and gratuities to every guest. It does not apply infant or under-4 exemptions.

Luggage allowance

1 hand-carry bag + 2 checked bags, up to 30 kg each. One additional 30 kg checked bag costs USD 50 round trip.

Ticketed guest name changes

USD 200 per pax. Available only until 20 days before departure.

Taxes & separate payments

Port charges: USD 150 per pax, collected with the cruise fare. Japan tourist arrival fee: USD 20 per pax, paid onboard. Gratuities follow the selected sailing and cabin category in your breakdown. Arrange travel insurance on your own.

PH travel tax: the calculator retains your specified PHP 1,620 per pax. The supplied flyer instead lists USD 30; confirm the applicable amount before payment. Pay through TIEZA ↗

Information transcribed from the supplied Adora flyers. Confirm arrangements with the cruise provider.
